versions.changelog:
Initial release of the lifecycle-progression-workflow skill.

- Provides step-by-step workflows to automate contact progression through sales stages: Lead → MQL → SQL → Opportunity → Customer.
- Supports three workflow-building options: manual UI build, HubSpot Breeze AI, and Claude Anthropic Chrome Extension.
- Includes detailed trigger conditions for each stage transition (score threshold, meeting booked, deal creation, closed-won).
- Covers prerequisites, setup instructions, and post-build verification steps.
- Notes on limitations such as HubSpot restrictions and event-based triggers in Breeze.
